444:t_007:19.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「He told you the truth about $$黒歴史$$ during $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$.」

444:t_007:20.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But now that Earth is in danger, there is something we must ask $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ to confirm.」

444:t_007:22.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「It is a deeper truth... What one might call the darkness of $$黒歴史$$.」

444:t_008:1.en:
$$シュレード$$
「He has already left the facility. Apparently, the truth $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ tells is inconvenient for him as well.」

444:t_008:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「That bastard... Is he attacking us just for fun...!?」

444:t_008:3.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「There's no point trying to make sense of $$ミカゲ$$!」

444:t_009:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm not letting that $$頭翅#pilot$$ look-alike take out $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$!」

444:t_010:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is... authorization from the $$サテライトキャノン$$'s microwave transmission facilities...」

444:t_010:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Awesome! With this many transmitters linked up, the microwaves will reach us in one minute, wherever we are!」

444:t_010:2.en:
$$パーラ$$
「So it doesn't matter whether the moon's out or not!」

444:t_010:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ティファ$$...? I can feel her close by, even though she should be on the ship...」

444:t_010:5.en:
$$ティファ$$
(I'll fight alongside you too, $$ガロード$$... Take my heart with you.)

444:t_010:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「With $$ティファ$$ by my side, I'm a hundred times stronger! Here I come, $$堕天翅$$s!」

444:t_010:7.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$! Please look after $$ディアナ$$!」

444:t_010:8.en:
$$ハリー$$
「Understood! Leave things here to me!」

444:t_010:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Watch out, everyone! $$ミカゲ$$ must be nearby!」

444:t_010:10.en:
$$ミコノ$$
(He's... using $$神話型アクエリオン$$ again...)

444:t_012:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「It's a black $$アクエリオン$$!」

444:t_012:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「Is that the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ $$アポロ$$ piloted!?」

444:t_012:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The true battle draws near... Let's see whether you can be of use.」

444:t_013:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Wingless have no need to know the truth. I have no intention of exposing myself to unnecessary danger.」

444:t_013:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ディアナ$$ is in there!」

444:t_015:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The moon is beautiful when viewed from Earth... But standing in its wastelands reveals that it is an empty world of nothingness.」

444:t_015:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You Wingless, who have no wings, should have been content to live on that beautiful planet.」

444:t_015:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「So you're going to destroy the moon!?」

444:t_015:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's right. By now, the Moon Queen's palace is probably engulfed in flames too.」

444:t_015:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「How could you do such a thing!?」

444:t_015:6.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ロラン・セアック$$, there is no need to engage that creature.」

444:t_015:8.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「It is true that our ancestors polluted Earth and came to this empty world...」

444:t_015:9.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「But here we brought forth new life and passed it on to the next generation.」

444:t_015:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Nonsense, Moon Queen. Those who feared evolution and shut off their own future have no right to say that.」

444:t_015:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Are you talking about $$ホワイトドール$$'s $$月光蝶$$!?」

444:t_015:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Exactly. Your $$ガンダム$$, with its butterfly wings, is a symbol of destruction.」

444:t_015:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「There is no future beyond that $$ガンダム$$. It is the final stop that shuts everything off.」

444:t_015:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You're wrong! The $$月光蝶$$ may have destroyed civilization, but humanity didn't end there!」

444:t_015:15.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Everyone's alive! And $$ホワイトドール$$ can use its power to protect them and create a future too!」

444:t_015:16.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$ロラン・セアック$$... As you are now, I believe you can wield the $$月光蝶$$'s power properly.」

444:t_015:17.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You can believe in $$ホワイトドール$$ and the future even after learning the darkness of $$黒歴史$$. I entrust all of the $$月光蝶$$ to you.」

444:t_016:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The seals on the $$月光蝶$$ system are being released...」

444:t_016:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ターンエー$$! You're going to protect the future too!!」

444:t_017:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The $$月光蝶$$ is absorbing the enemy machines' energy!」

444:t_017:1.en:
$$レド$$
「It has the same effect as $$ガルガンティア$$'s nanomachines!」

444:t_017:2.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「$$翠星蟲$$, designed to remove ocean pollution, can absorb energy and release electrical energy.」

444:t_017:3.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「The $$月光蝶$$ was developed from them. Alongside its power to break down matter, it retains those functions.」

444:t_017:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I think that must be thanks to people who believed the $$月光蝶$$ would someday be used to restore Earth too.」

444:t_018:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The endpoint of the civilization of fire... So you will unleash that power.」

444:t_018:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Shut up, fake $$頭翅#pilot$$! We'll finish you and that black $$アクエリオン$$ off, then head for the lunar city!」

444:t_019:0.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Leave the battle there to us.」

444:t_019:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I knew you were still alive!」

444:t_019:3.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「We are working with the colonies' $$宇宙革命軍$$ to fight $$サイデリアル$$ around $$翠の地球$$.」

444:t_019:4.en:
$$ウィッツ$$
「That's right! Don't go assuming we're dead!」

444:t_019:5.en:
$$ロアビィ$$
「We'll handle things on our end. We're counting on you on yours, $c!」

444:t_019:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ウィッツ$$! $$ロアビィ$$!」

444:t_019:7.en:
$$ロアビィ$$
「You're the same as ever, $$ガロード$$. Keep at it, and take good care of $$ティファ$$.」

444:t_019:8.en:
$$ウィッツ$$
「$$トニヤ$$, $$サラ$$, $$シンゴ$$, $$キッド$$, the doctor, and $$エニル$$ are all doing fine!」

444:t_019:9.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「$$ガロード$$... You, $$パーラ$$, and $$ティファ$$ represent the $$フリーデン$$. I'm counting on you.」

444:t_019:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah! Leave it to me!」

444:t_019:12.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You are a pitiful creature.」

444:t_019:14.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「You resemble me... Living forever has made you forget how wonderful humans, with their finite lives, can be.」

444:t_019:15.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Humans have no eternity... So through their bonds with one another, they connect the past to the future.」
